limitations: No new upstream CTest passes are counted here.
Shared application linking is an experiment; dependency/rpath, C embedding, and broader conformance validation remain.
Compiler/side-module CLI controls use the recorded one-worker profile; four-worker and original broad-campaign results remain separate.
Full shared-runtime link exposes unresolved libuv internals in retained linker warnings; tested executions do not call them.
Bun result is the local rebuilt engine, not stock Bun or a portable package guarantee.
Native macOS, Windows, ARM64 and packaged integration remain unverified.
